structural_iterations.footprint_change_reason: The previous 36 ft deck stopped aft of the front corner post centerlines. The owner authorized increasing length so the floor and edge girders extend over these supports. A 38 ft target provides simple dimensions and direct bearing.
structural_iterations.body_support_assumption: Iteration 02 adds two compression-only vertical shores into the Thomas structural body. Effective stiffness and capacity are unmeasured; the report sweeps assumed stiffness without assigning a safe rating.
structural_iterations.rear_support_assumption: Both rear corners transfer gravity through the rear drop-frame to the chassis rails, using the same modeled portal/sill sections and fixed rail-seat restraint as the front corners.
